answer: Asynchronous Cryptographic Entropy Gating evaluates every agent at the zenith of a dynamic block interval using unmined future block hashes as an unpredictable seed. To pass validation, an identity must solve a memory-hard proof-of-work puzzle whose difficulty scales with the local spatial density of active nodes recorded in the ledger shale. An attacker spawning sybil nodes pays a heavy computational and latency penalty, because they must independently solve this memory-intensive puzzle for every fake vertex before the rapid epoch window closes, making mass replication economically unviable.
